rows.grounds: compound of hṛt, pāda, ambhoruha, and chāyā in accusative singular feminine
imperative second singular active of root dā

items.question: What shade should the guru's heart-lotus-feet bestow upon the disciple's head?
premises: grace is shade of lotus feet
items.inference: The verse frames initiation as receiving the guru's heart-lotus shade upon the head.
uncertainties: compound segmentation of hṛtpādāmbhoruhacchāyāṃ is interpretive
items.plain_english: Give the shade of the heart-lotus feet upon my head, O purifier of fame.
